<!-- Product Definition (LLM-extractable summary) -->
<div class="section section-gray">
<div class="container">

<div class="definition-box">
<strong>Praevius</strong> is AI-powered construction cost control software that gives subcontractors and quantity surveying professionals real-time budget visibility, automated variance detection, and progress claim automation. Starting at $99/month with a free tier available, it replaces manual cost tracking with professional-grade tools including AI-generated variance reports, S-curve forecasting, change order management, and integrations with Xero Invoicing, QuickBooks Online, Sage Intacct and Procore ↔ SharePoint Sync. Every plan includes Praevius Project, a programme module with Gantt, critical path, baselines and MS Project or Asta import. Built by quantity surveyors with 20 years of international construction experience. Supports UK (JCT/NEC), US (AIA), and Australian (SOPA) contract formats.
</div>

<h2 class="section-title">Complete <span>Subcontractor Cost Tracking</span> Solution</h2>

<p class="text-center mb-4" style="max-width: 800px; margin: 0 auto;">
Praevius is <strong>quantity surveying software</strong> built specifically for UK and Australian trade contractors. Our <strong>construction progress claim software</strong> eliminates spreadsheet chaos and gives you real-time visibility into every project's budget performance. <a href="features.html">Explore all features</a>.
</p>

</div>
</div>
